verdict.rationale: Loops documents an email editor, brand-consistency settings (colors/type/spacing applied automatically), dynamic personalization variables, and reusable content built via templates/Content API (loops-docs-17, loops-docs-18, loops-docs-2, loops-docs-9, loops-docs-14). Community evidence confirms the editor is a customizable, text-based system built on extended MJML (loops-comm-7), which supports templating but is not a classic drag-and-drop visual builder, and no evidence addresses cross-client rendering testing or guarantees. missing for 10: explicit cross-email-client rendering validation, confirmation of a fully visual (non-code) editor experience, independent hands-on review of template reuse in practice.
